name: IdentifiersOrg_resolve
description: Resolve a biological identifier to its resource URLs using Identifiers.org. Given a namespace (e.g., 'uniprot') and local ID (e.g., 'P04637'), returns all resolved URLs across different providers (NCBI, EBI, UniProt, etc.). Identifiers.org is an ELIXIR service that provides persistent identifiers for life science data. Supports 800+ namespaces including uniprot, pdb, ensembl, go, reactome, kegg, ncbigene, taxonomy, and many more. Use this to find where a biological entity can be accessed across databases.

namespace.description: Database namespace prefix. Examples: 'uniprot', 'pdb', 'ncbigene', 'go', 'taxonomy', 'reactome', 'ensembl', 'kegg.compound', 'interpro', 'pfam'. Find available namespaces using IdentifiersOrg_search_namespaces.

local_id.description: The local identifier within the namespace. Examples: 'P04637' (for uniprot), '4HHB' (for pdb), '7157' (for ncbigene), '0006915' (for go), '9606' (for taxonomy), 'R-HSA-73857' (for reactome), 'ENSG00000141510' (for ensembl).

oneOf.description: Resolution results containing resolved resource URLs

deprecatedNamespace.description: True when the namespace prefix the caller used has been retired. The call still resolves, which is exactly why this flag matters.

namespaceEmbeddedInLui.description: True when the namespace prefix is part of the local id itself (as in 'CHEBI:17234'), so the id must not have the prefix stripped before use.

rawRequest.description: The compact identifier exactly as received, e.g. 'uniprot:P04637'. What was parsed, before any normalisation.

renderDeprecatedLanding.description: Whether Identifiers.org would still show a landing page for the deprecated namespace.

description.description: The institution's own description of itself, e.g. 'The National Center for Biotechnology Information advances science and health by providing...'.

id.description: Identifiers.org's numeric id for the institution, e.g. 26.

rorId.description: The institution's ROR identifier as a URL, e.g. 'https://ror.org/02meqm098'. Links the provider to the global research-organisation registry.

deprecatedNamespace.description: True when the namespace prefix the caller used has been retired. The call still resolves, which is exactly why this flag matters.

deprecatedResource.description: True when this particular provider has been retired. Resolving to it will likely fail, and it is listed alongside live providers.

id.description: Identifiers.org's internal numeric id for the resource, e.g. 27.

location.description: The country the resource is hosted in, as 'countryCode' and 'countryName'. Which jurisdiction the data is served from, and it can differ from the institution's own.

mirId.description: The resource's permanent MIR identifier, e.g. 'MIR:00100330'. The stable way to name one provider; the numeric id is not guaranteed stable.

namespacePrefix.description: The namespace this provider serves, e.g. 'uniprot'. Says which of the resolved providers belong to the requested namespace.

protectedUrls.description: True when the provider's URLs sit behind authentication, so the resolved URL will not open for an anonymous caller.

recommendation.description: Identifiers.org's own advice on the provider: 'recommendationIndex' (higher is more recommended) and 'recommendationExplanation'. Which of several resolved URLs to prefer - the list order does not say.

renderDeprecatedLanding.description: Whether a landing page is still rendered for this deprecated resource.

renderProtectedLanding.description: Whether Identifiers.org shows an interstitial page for those protected URLs.

name: IdentifiersOrg_get_namespace
description: Get detailed information about a specific Identifiers.org namespace (database prefix). Returns the namespace name, ID pattern regex, description, sample ID, and provider resources. Use this to understand the identifier format for a specific database (e.g., what a valid UniProt ID looks like). The prefix is the part before the colon in a compact ID (e.g., 'uniprot' in 'uniprot:P04637'). There are 800+ registered namespaces covering most major biological databases.

prefix.description: The namespace prefix to look up. Examples: 'uniprot', 'pdb', 'ensembl', 'go', 'chebi', 'ncbigene', 'taxonomy', 'reactome', 'kegg.compound', 'interpro', 'pfam', 'doi'.

oneOf.description: Namespace details including ID pattern and description

pattern.description: Regex pattern for valid local IDs

_links.description: HAL links for the namespace - self, namespace, successor, resources, contactPerson and curationWarnings. 'successor' is where a retired namespace points, and 'curationWarnings' is where Identifiers.org records known problems with it.

created.description: When the namespace was registered, e.g. '2019-06-11T14:15:29.457+00:00'.

modified.description: When its registration was last changed, e.g. '2025-08-28T14:39:34.041+00:00'.

renderDeprecatedLanding.description: Whether Identifiers.org still shows a landing page for the namespace if it has been deprecated.

name: IdentifiersOrg_search_namespaces
description: Search the Identifiers.org registry for namespaces (database prefixes) by keyword. Returns namespaces whose prefix contains the search term. Use this to discover what database prefixes are available for resolving identifiers. For example, search 'pdb' to find PDB-related namespaces, or 'gene' to find all gene-related databases registered in Identifiers.org.

content.description: Search term to find in namespace prefixes. Examples: 'pdb', 'gene', 'protein', 'uniprot', 'ensembl', 'kegg', 'chebi', 'pathway'.

name: IdentifiersOrg_list_namespaces
description: List all registered namespaces in the Identifiers.org registry with pagination. Returns database prefixes, names, ID patterns, and descriptions for all 800+ registered biological databases. Use this to browse available namespaces or find databases you may not have known about. Results are paginated with configurable page size.
